auth: Approved users use the token cookie issued at /login. Pending users use the temporary session until approval. JWT verification keys are published through JWKS.

endpoints.GET /.well-known/jwks.json: JSON Web Key Set used to publish JWT verification keys
endpoints.GET /api/user/me: Return the authenticated user profile fields
endpoints.GET /settings/export: Queue a personal data export (returns status)

note: Admin endpoints are not listed here. Discover them through the UI.
